# T-1: Define help metadata model

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Create or formalize the normalized metadata shape and renderer input that can represent core and plugin command help surfaces.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Metadata can represent command name, section, summary, usage, args/options, experimental marker, locale source, and subcommands.
- Metadata normalization uses a shared helper or class rather than duplicated object-shaping logic.
- Renderer input supports both core command registry entries and plugin command entries.

## Implementation Notes
Prefer existing registry patterns and introduce a class only where it enforces useful invariants or hides renderer complexity.

## Test Strategy
Unit-test metadata normalization for core and plugin command examples.
